name: 06 Chatbot: ask which workflow does what

parameters.content:
## Chatbot: ask which workflow does X
The Chat Trigger gives you a hosted chat page. Each message is handed to workflow 07 (Execute Workflow = one workflow calling another and waiting for the result). The answer is logged to Postgres, then sent back to the chat.

The Chat Trigger in 'last node' mode needs the final node to output `{ output: text }`; that is what the Reply node does.

parameters.initialMessages: Ask me which workflow handles something, e.g. "what happens when a call is missed?" or "how do follow-ups work?"

options.title: Workflow helper
options.subtitle: Backed by n8n workflow 07 and Postgres/pgvector

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('When chat message received').item.json.sessionId, $('When chat message received').item.json.chatInput, $json.answer, $json.matchedWorkflowId || null, $json.similarity ?? null] }}
